description: Perigon is a news intelligence API over a large article index. This plugin searches articles (one result per published URL), lists story clusters, journalists and resolved people and company entities, and reads the account's usage and limits.

api.description: Search news articles: one result per published URL, filterable by query, topic, category, source, country, language and dates
